script: if doc.stock_entry_type == "Material Receipt": stock_entry_data = { "doctype": "Stock Entry", "stock_entry_type": "Material Issue", "company": doc.company, "posting_date": doc.posting_date, "posting_time": doc.posting_time, "set_warehouse": doc.set_warehouse, "items": [] } fresh_doc = frappe.get_doc("Stock Entry", doc.name) log_rows = [] for row in fresh_doc.items: raw_material = row.get("custom_raw_material_item") qty_before_loss = float(row.get("custom_qty_before_loss") or 0) item_code = row.get("item_code", "❓") custom_loss = row.get("custom_loss", "N/A") log_rows.append( f"Item: {item_code} | " f"Raw Material: {raw_material or '❌'} | " f"custom_qty_before_loss: {qty_before_loss} | " f"custom_loss: {custom_loss}" ) if raw_material and qty_before_loss > 0: item_doc = frappe.get_doc("Item", raw_material) warehouse = None for d in item_doc.get("item_defaults", []): if d.company == doc.company: warehouse = d.default_warehouse break if not warehouse: frappe.throw(f"🚫 Default warehouse not set for raw material item: {raw_material}") stock_entry_data_dict={ "item_code": raw_material, "qty": qty_before_loss, "s_warehouse": warehouse, "uom": item_doc.stock_uom, "stock_uom": item_doc.stock_uom, "conversion_factor": 1, "custom_qty_before_loss":qty_before_loss, "custom_loss":0 } stock_entry_data["items"].append(stock_entry_data_dict) # frappe.log_error("🧾 Stock Entry Item Batch Log", "\n".join(log_rows)) # frappe.log_error("📦 Final Payload", str(stock_entry_data_dict)) # ← Fixed this line if stock_entry_data["items"]: created_entry = frappe.get_doc(stock_entry_data) created_entry.insert() created_entry.submit() frappe.msgprint(f"✅ Material Issue auto-created: {created_entry.name}", indicator="green")
